component.name: MaterialCraft
component.summary: Design procedural PBR materials with node graphs

description.p: This is a community package of MaterialCraft, maintained independently and unaffiliated with the MaterialCraft project. It repackages the official upstream Linux release build unmodified.

MaterialCraft is an open-source, native node-based material designer: build tileable PBR materials from noises, patterns and filters in a node graph, preview them live in 2D and 3D, and export the texture maps for any engine.

ul.li: Hundreds of procedural nodes: noises, patterns, adjustments, blurs, warps, normal and height tools
Live 2D and 3D previews with physically based shading
Export base color, normal, roughness, metallic, height and ambient occlusion maps as PNG, EXR, TGA, JPEG or TIFF; save packages as .mcraft
Every action is a command, scriptable from a CLI, a JSON control channel and an MCP server

description.p: The headless command runner and MCP server is included: flatpak run --command=materialcraft-cli ai.storyteller.materialcraft --help

Permissions: this package uses the same sandbox as upstream's own Flatpak manifest: display (Wayland, with X11 as a fallback), the GPU device, and the Pictures and Documents folders. Files anywhere else are opened and saved through the system file chooser. No network access is granted.

ul.li: Let agents on the host reach the --control automation server: flatpak override --user --share=network ai.storyteller.materialcraft
Open files by path anywhere in your home folder (command line, Open Recent): flatpak override --user --filesystem=home ai.storyteller.materialcraft
